```js
const { DateTime } = require("luxon");
const dt = DateTime.fromRFC2822("01 Nov 2016 13:23:12 UT");
dt.isValid;       // false, expected true
dt.invalidReason; // "unparsable", expected null
```

The same string with `GMT` instead of `UT` parses correctly, so it looks like `UT` simply isn't recognized.
